SELECT account_no AS accountNo, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, is_deleted AS isDeleted, account_id AS accountId, account_name AS accountName, -- 一覧表示ではパスワードハッシュを取得しない（NULL固定で射影する） CAST(NULL AS text) AS password, birthdate, sex_kbn AS sexKbn, birthplace_prefecture_kbn_code AS birthplacePrefectureKbnCode, resident_prefecture_kbn_code AS residentPrefectureKbnCode, free_memo AS freeMemo, authority_kbn AS authorityKbn, last_login_datetime AS lastLoginDatetime, login_failure_count AS loginFailureCount, is_admin_locked AS isAdminLocked FROM common.account
ORDER BY account_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.account ( account_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, account_id, account_name, password, birthdate, sex_kbn, birthplace_prefecture_kbn_code, resident_prefecture_kbn_code, free_memo, authority_kbn, last_login_datetime, login_failure_count, is_admin_locked ) VALUES ( nextval('common.account_account_no_seq'), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW(), false, #{accountId}, #{accountName}, #{password}, #{birthdate}, #{sexKbn}::common.sex_enum, #{birthplacePrefectureKbnCode}, #{residentPrefectureKbnCode}, #{freeMemo}, #{authorityKbn}::common.authority_enum, #{lastLoginDatetime}, #{loginFailureCount}, COALESCE(#{isAdminLocked}, false) )
mapper.update: UPDATE common.account SET login_failure_count = login_failure_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select: SELECT account_no FROM common.account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} FOR UPDATE
WITH advisory_lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{accountId}, 0)) ) SELECT 1 FROM advisory_lock
